decisions.reason: The candidate already records the required equity IRR output and 16–20% target from this message; the source Event changes how the availability payment is sized, not the return-analysis requirement.
Availability-payment sizing does not change the required CCA classes, depreciation treatment, tax-shield modeling, or treatment of equity-return effects.
The dual DSCR and equity IRR sizing targets do not alter the separately specified 55/45 debt-equity structure, approximate interest rate, or exclusion of mezzanine financing.
The availability-payment sizing decision does not change the operating-cost range, network scope, assumption status, or prohibition on using the Appendix opex amount.
The source decision changes the sizing criteria within the availability-payment approach but does not change the requirement to compare Case F with the availability-payment PPP Case G.
Availability-payment sizing does not alter the twelve-site network, site typologies, treatment of missing site details, or authoritative site list.

The candidate's existing requirement to demonstrate that availability payments are necessary remains valid unchanged; the source Event specifies the separate calculation criteria for sizing those payments.
The sizing targets do not resolve or change the model currency, price-base year, or the existing AUD-versus-CAD ambiguity.

The debt schedule must continue producing DSCR, while the approximately 1.65x threshold is a sizing criterion owned by the availability-payment requirement; no debt-schedule attribute is necessarily changed.
The availability-payment sizing criteria do not change the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
The source decision does not add, remove, or alter any sensitivity-analysis dimension.
The dual-target availability-payment sizing rule does not change the requirement to retain an integrated three-statement model.
